title: Starbucks Iridescent Mermaid Scales 24oz Cold Cup Tumbler W/Lid - No Straw
descriptionText:
This Starbucks coffee cup tumbler is a must-have for any coffee and tea lover! The cup features a stunning iridescent mermaid scale design that is sure to catch the eye of anyone who sees it. With a 24oz capacity, this cup is perfect for enjoying your favorite cold beverage on the go.

The cup is an original Starbucks product, created in 2019 and manufactured in China. It comes with a lid to help keep your drink cold and refreshing. The green color of the cup adds a pop of color to any collection of Starbucks merchandise. This collectible item is perfect for anyone who loves coffee and tea, and it is sure to become a favorite among Starbucks fans.
